findings.shortQuote: 嘗略屬真番朝鮮〈如淳云燕嘗略二國以屬己也應劭云𤣥莬本直番國〉
findings.summary: Volume covers 朝鮮列傳第五十五. Ying Shao's gloss equates Xuantu's territory with the former Zhenfan polity - an ancient textual basis for the northern/Liaodong view. Received text writes the variant 直番 for 真番 and 𤣥莬 for 玄菟.
findings.licenseEvidence: Public domain worldwide (author died >100 years ago, published before 1931-01-01); site text CC BY-SA 4.0

findings.shortQuote: 元封三年癸酉 分朝鮮爲四郡 曰眞番 臨屯 玄菟 樂浪
findings.summary: Lists Jinbeon as one of the four commanderies but gives no location, no modern identification, no coordinate.

incidentalLead.observation: TGAZ record JSON exposes explicit begin_rule / end_rule fields. hvd_112645 has begin=24, begin_rule=3, end=0, end_rule=0. Because begin 24 CE with end 0 would be chronologically impossible as a real year, end=0 with end_rule=0 behaves as an unknown/unset marker rather than a year. This is an inference from one record, NOT a documented spec. chgis.hudci.org/tgaz/about returned an empty body.
